summary.name: From Zero to Hero: Recommended Practices for Training your Ever-Evolving SRE Teams
summary.one_liner: A 2015 SREcon talk by Google's Andrew Widdowson on practices for training new Site Reliability Engineers and keeping existing SREs up to date.
use_cases: training newest teammates on production systems
keeping senior SREs current on evolving stacks
building a teaching culture in an SRE team
summary.what_it_does: The page describes a conference talk, not a tool. Andrew Widdowson presents practices Google uses to train new SREs faster and keep experienced ones sharp as systems change. Topics named include encouraging large scale systems thinking, providing hands-on learning opportunities, and conveying the technical and philosophical aspects of effective SRE work. The talk is tied to SREcon15 at the Hyatt Regency Santa Clara, and the page includes a BibTeX citation. Widdowson is a Staff Software Engineer at Google who leads the internal "SRE EDU" teaching effort.
notable: Describes Google's internal SRE EDU teaching effort, as led by the speaker
Covers training new SREs and keeping existing ones current in one talk
Part of the USENIX SREcon15 conference program (March 2015)
caveats: Page is a conference session listing; the talk content itself is only summarized, not included
Registration fee of $400 applies to attending the conference
